jobs.title: Director, AI Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Technology Services

Technology Services (TS) is responsible for delivering all enterprise infrastructure, applications and related end user technology services across all Brookfield business groups.

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Role Summary

Leads the design of enterprise AI solutions that align business priorities, data foundations, architecture standards, and platform capabilities. This role translates complex business needs into scalable, secure, and governed AI solution designs, including GenAI and agent-based use cases. Partners with business, product, data, engineering, security, and governance teams to move high-value AI solutions from concept to production.

Key Responsibilities

Assess business problems and define end-to-end AI solution architectures aligned to enterprise priorities
Translate product and business requirements into scalable, secure, and supportable AI designs
Define architecture patterns for AI, GenAI, retrieval-based, and agent-enabled solutions
Ensure solution designs are grounded in trusted data, integration, and platform architecture standards
Partner with product owners, data architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to shape implementation roadmaps
Guide technology selection, integration patterns, and design decisions across AI solution components
Establish non-functional requirements for security, governance, performance, resiliency, and supportability
Ensure AI solutions align with responsible AI, risk, compliance, and control requirements Review and govern solution designs through architecture checkpoints and design standards
Support pilots, production deployments, and architecture evolution based on business feedback and operational learnings

Required Experience

10+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, data architecture, or AI-related roles
Proven experience designing and delivering complex enterprise technology solutions across multiple systems and stakeholders
Experience with AI, machine learning, GenAI, or advanced analytics solutions in production environments
Experience working with cloud platforms, enterprise data ecosystems, APIs, and integration patterns
Experience operating in regulated, security-conscious, or highly governed enterprise environments
Experience partnering with business leaders to translate strategic priorities into architecture designs

Skills & Qualifications

Technical knowledge and systems expertise: Deep understanding of enterprise architecture, AI and machine learning, GenAI, data platforms, integration patterns, and the data foundations required for scalable AI and agent-based solutions.
Analytical and problem-solving skills: Ability to assess complex business and technical challenges and translate them into scalable, practical, and governed solution designs.
Communication and collaboration capabilities: Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional influence skills.
Ability to work in cross-functional or global teams: Experience operating across global teams and aligning business, product, architecture, engineering, security, and governance stakeholders.
Understanding of technology governance, security, or operational practices: Strong understanding of responsible AI, risk management, security, compliance, and operational design requirements for enterprise AI solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in financial services, asset management, or similarly complex industries
Experience designing AI solutions that support decision-making, workflow automation, or knowledge-based use cases
Familiarity with modern cloud-based data and AI platforms and MLOps or model operations practices
Experience with architecture governance, design review processes, or enterprise architecture frameworks
Exposure to retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge architectures, or agent orchestration patterns

Salary Range: $150,000 - $185,000 CAD

Position Opening Reason:

New Position

jobs.title: Lead Python and Generative AI Engineer- Vice President
jobs.description:
We're searching for a highly skilled and experienced senior engineer and Python expert to lead the design and development of the various AI-related technologies as part of Services Tech AI team. The ideal candidate has an excellent track record in high-scale engineering products and specifically AI solutions. In this role, you'll be a key player in driving innovative AI projects throughout the bank.

Responsibilities

Lead the design, development, and maintenance of highly complex Python-based GenAI platforms, applications, services, and supporting infrastructure to ensure seamless operation, scalability, and integration of AI capabilities across various Citi business units.
Engage with data science, technical, and business stakeholders to define and design overall architecture for key use-cases, specifically focusing on Python-based solutions for our lines of business.
Drive the deployment of new GenAI products and process improvements, working with internal and external partners to design, validate, and deliver solutions with commercial benefit for Citi, with a strong emphasis on robust Python implementations.
Resolve high-impact technical and business problems, leading projects through in-depth evaluation of complex GenAI business processes, system architecture, and industry standards, providing innovative Python-driven solutions.
Provide expert guidance and advanced knowledge in Python-based programming, ensuring platform design adheres to architectural blueprints and best practices for generative models.
Develop and enforce robust Python coding standards, testing methodologies, debugging practices, and implementation strategies for enterprise-grade solutions, leveraging an advanced understanding of system flow.
Manage multiple concurrent initiatives and projects of varying sizes and complexity, engaging with external vendors and startups for joint initiatives and exploration of new directions, particularly those involving Python-based technologies.
Cultivate a comprehensive understanding of how business, architecture, and infrastructure integrate within the GenAI ecosystem at Citi to achieve strategic goals.
Serve as an advisor and coach to mid-level developers and analysts specializing in Python and GenAI technologies, fostering skill development and effective work allocation.
Collaborate with Citi's Risk and Control teams to ensure best practices are followed regarding governance, risk management, standardization, and tooling for Python-based GenAI systems.

Skills & Qualifications

10+ years of experience in the software industry, with a strong emphasis on building enterprise software.
6+ years of relevant experience in developing and implementing scalable and robuest Python-based platforms for AI-driven applications and systems using salient Python libraries (e.g., FastAPI, Flask, Django, Pandas, NumPy, Prefect, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face).
5+ years of experience delivering complex Python-based solutions and services (e.g., backend services, APIs) into production.
Demonstrated experience in managing and implementing successful projects of varying sizes and complexities.
Proven understanding of Generative AI systems, AIOps, and application monitoring/evaluation.
Experience with cloud architectures, with specific experience in public cloud offerings.
Strong passion and proven hands-on experience integrating with AI/ML technologies, particularly using Python.
Experience with software development agents, agile development, CI/CD pipelines, software testing, and code reviews.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, adjust priorities, influence highly skilled engineering teams, and guide technology decisions.
Demonstrated leadership and project management skills.
Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both written and verbal.
Strong analytical, problem-solving skills, and a strategic mindset.
Experience in the financial industry is a significant advantage.

Education

Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience is required.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Digital Marketing Operations
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Work Arrangement:
This is a hybrid position requiring candidates to work on-site at least 2 days per week at our office in Mississauga. The remaining days may be worked remotely, subject to team and business needs.

About the Role (Job Summary):

The Sr. Director, Digital Marketing Operations is responsible for shaping and executing the organization's digital platform and marketing technology strategy. This leader oversees digital products, marketing platforms, operational processes, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-performing digital experiences that support business growth and customer engagement.

This role combines strategic leadership, digital product management, marketing technology (MarTech) expertise, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making. The successful candidate will partner closely with Marketing, Technology, Digital Product, and Business leaders to optimize platforms, improve operational effectiveness, and advance digital transformation initiatives.

What You'll Do (Responsibilities):

Digital Strategy & Leadership:

Develop and execute a multi-year digital platform and marketing technology strategy aligned with organizational and commercial objectives.
Establish strategic priorities, operational standards, performance metrics, and governance frameworks for digital marketing operations.
Lead and develop high-performing teams, fostering collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Digital Product & Platform Management:

Own the roadmap and lifecycle management of digital products, including websites, mobile applications, and other marketing-enabled platforms.
Partner with Technology and Digital Product teams to prioritize enhancements, ensure platform reliability, and deliver exceptional user experiences.
Represent business stakeholder requirements throughout planning, development, testing, and deployment activities.

Marketing Technology & Operations:

Oversee the selection, implementation, integration, and optimization of marketing technology solutions, including CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, content management systems, and analytics platforms.
Establish operational processes and governance to support the efficient deployment of marketing content across owned digital channels.
Drive operational excellence through process improvement initiatives and automation opportunities.

Analytics & Performance Optimization:

Evaluate performance metrics, customer insights, and digital analytics to measure effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
Translate data into actionable recommendations that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving digital best practices to maintain a competitive advantage.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management:

Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders, senior leadership, and external vendors.
Manage vendor relationships, contract negotiations, service-level agreements, and solution delivery performance.
Influence enterprise-wide decisions related to digital capabilities, technology investments, and operational priorities.

Basic Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience in digital marketing, marketing operations, marketing technology, digital product management, or related disciplines.
5+ years of people leadership experience, including leadership of managers and cross-functional teams.
Ability to analyze data and market trends to inform strategic decisions.
Experience developing and executing digital platform, marketing technology, or digital transformation strategies.
Experience managing websites, mobile applications, digital platforms, or enterprise marketing technology solutions.
Experience working with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, content management systems, and digital analytics solutions.
Experience managing budgets and optimizing ROI.
Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
Experience in healthcare, retail, distribution, or other highly regulated industries.
Bilingualism (English and French) is considered an asset.

We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, please click here.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Pricing Strategy
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

The Commercial Excellence Lead plays a pivotal role in elevating EY’s commercial performance across Canada’s most strategic and high value pursuits. With AI as a catalyst in the way professional services are delivered and priced it becomes it is important to continue to evolve the systems that support the firm in understanding market signals as well as adapting our support across all service lines.

As part of the Strategic Deals Team, this role will work closely with all service lines, account teams, engagement leaders, industry & sector groups to help consolidate market signals and shape pricing strategies, guiding pursuit teams through commercial decision making, and coaching teams to articulate EY Canada’s differentiated value in an increasingly AI first marketplace.

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence complex internal and external stakeholders.

Your Key Responsibilities:

Shape and support the evolution of our pricing capabilities in Canada from consolidating market insights, to supporting pricing strategies and change management across our practices and teams.
Help establish EY Canada's pricing strategy for big deals/strategic pursuits, driving value-based pricing aligned with AI-enabled delivery, technology investment and evolving delivery model.
Collaborate with deal coaches and act as a pricing advisor in shaping commercial narratives
Guide account, engagement, and pursuit teams in pricing decisions, ensuring clarity between known vs. unknown AI related efficiencies and protecting margins while demonstrating value to clients.
Partner with all services lines and Clients & Industries teams to bring consistency to pricing models, commercial structures, negotiation strategies, and GTM narratives.
Partner with account, engagement, industry, sector leaders and teams to shape go-to-market strategy and articulate differentiated value propositions.
Enhance pursuit performance using data-driven insights, deal economics, and financial analysis to inform commercial decisions.
Foster commercial excellence across teams through coaching, collaboration with Global and Super Region Sales and Commercial Excellence teams and alignment with EY’s transformation and GTM priorities.
Create pricing insights tools that can be leveraged across the firm
Become an expert in all existing pricing tools (Regionally and Globally)
Train additional resources in pricing best practices, tools and technology
Develop a network across Super Regions to continually improve our pricing practices

Skills and attributes for success:

Minimum 8-12 years of experience in professional services, consulting, or strategic sales.
Experience in commercial activities, such as go-to-market strategy, pricing and sales
Strong analytical skills, financial analysis and forecasting, strategic thinking, and excellent communication and negotiation skills.
Understanding of engagement lifecycle management, risk assessment, and the ability to interact with senior management levels.
Experience working with senior stakeholders, specifically top team executives.
Strong facilitation, communication, and influencing skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

What We Offer

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any accommodations you may need.

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. The opportunity

Winning isn’t just about the close. It’s about how organizations experience our differentiated value proposition at the beginning and across the middle that will ultimately define our future success as a professional services firm. Getting there means delivering meaningful touchpoints in the right ways and at the right time to create distinctly personal content and joined-up experiences for clients and potential clients that help answer the big questions they’re asking every single day.

jobs.title: Director, Planning
jobs.description:
Job Description

As Director, Planning, you will be responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, and performance of all planning activities across shipbuilding and ship repair programs. This role will ensure that integrated, credible, and risk-informed plans are developed, maintained, and used as key management tools to support on-time and efficient project delivery.

You will provide functional leadership to the planning organization, establish standards and best practices, and work closely with the Project Management, Operations, Engineering, and Finance Departments, as well as senior management, to support decision-making at both the project and portfolio levels.

More Specifically, You Will

Define and lead the enterprise planning strategy, including standards, methodologies, tools, and governance across all programs.
Ensure project and program plans accurately reflect execution strategy, contractual commitments, scope, and project maturity, while maintaining planning integrity, consistency, and compliance throughout the organization.
Provide executive oversight of integrated program and project planning activities, including milestones, sequencing, critical interfaces, constraints, and recovery strategies.
Assess planning performance, trends, and risks at the portfolio level, proactively identifying leading indicators and escalating material issues with clear, actionable recommendations to senior management.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure planning quality, predictability, readiness, and delivery performance.
Ensure robust progress measurement, forecasting, and alignment with cost, earned value, and project controls reporting to support informed management decisions.
Oversee the evaluation of planning impacts related to changes, delays, claims, and replanning activities, ensuring risks, assumptions, and recovery scenarios are clearly articulated and supported by credible analysis.
Lead and develop the planning organization, ensuring appropriate capabilities, capacity, and succession planning are in place to support current and future programs.
Set clear expectations for performance, accountability, and continuous improvement, and attract, retain, and develop senior planning talent.
Act as the senior planning authority and trusted advisor to senior management.

Qualifications

Ten to fifteen (10–15) years of progressive experience in planning, project controls, or a related field, including at least five (5) years in a supervisory role.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
Significant experience supporting large‑scale shipbuilding and/or ship repair projects is a strong asset.
Strong knowledge and demonstrated ability to apply project controls principles and methodologies aligned with AACEI and PMI (PMBOK) standard practices.
Sound understanding of project delivery phases and associated activities and deliverables.
Working knowledge of Earned Value Measurement (EVM – ANSI/EIA-748-B) in engineering, procurement, and construction.
Working knowledge of risk management principles and methodologies.
Demonstrated understanding of the interrelationships between good technical project scope definition, planning quality, estimating, construction sequencing, execution strategy, procurement and contracting strategies, commissioning, and start-up.
Ability to manage the impact of changes and trends related to budget control and ETC and EAC analysis.
Strong understanding of cross-functional interfaces with engineering, supply chain (materials and subcontracts), construction, safety, quality, finance and accounting, and operations.
Ability to work effectively as an integral part of a large team, including the client, engineering disciplines, the senior management team, and third-party suppliers.
Effective verbal and written communication skills with superiors, colleagues, and internal and external individuals.
Bilingualism (French and English). Proficiency in english and french is required for this position, as the incumbent will interact in both languages with our clients, partners, and suppliers.
High degree of teamwork and collaboration with other team members, including fast-paced deadline pressures.
Excellent knowledge of Excel, including pivot tables, formulas, and import/export features.
Proficiency in Primavera P6, or at a minimum, comprehensive knowledge of its use and capabilities in integrated planning and project controls environments.
Good working knowledge of financial systems and project management techniques (planning, budget control, etc.).
Ability to prioritize assignments, deal with interruptions, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment, while producing high-quality work.
Attention to details.
Successful completion of the investigation and security clearance process required under the federal government’s Contract Security Program.

About Us

new_jobs.title: Associate Director, Pricing Strategy
new_jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

The Commercial Excellence Lead plays a pivotal role in elevating EY’s commercial performance across Canada’s most strategic and high value pursuits. With AI as a catalyst in the way professional services are delivered and priced it becomes it is important to continue to evolve the systems that support the firm in understanding market signals as well as adapting our support across all service lines.

As part of the Strategic Deals Team, this role will work closely with all service lines, account teams, engagement leaders, industry & sector groups to help consolidate market signals and shape pricing strategies, guiding pursuit teams through commercial decision making, and coaching teams to articulate EY Canada’s differentiated value in an increasingly AI first marketplace.

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence complex internal and external stakeholders.

Your Key Responsibilities:

Shape and support the evolution of our pricing capabilities in Canada from consolidating market insights, to supporting pricing strategies and change management across our practices and teams.
Help establish EY Canada's pricing strategy for big deals/strategic pursuits, driving value-based pricing aligned with AI-enabled delivery, technology investment and evolving delivery model.
Collaborate with deal coaches and act as a pricing advisor in shaping commercial narratives
Guide account, engagement, and pursuit teams in pricing decisions, ensuring clarity between known vs. unknown AI related efficiencies and protecting margins while demonstrating value to clients.
Partner with all services lines and Clients & Industries teams to bring consistency to pricing models, commercial structures, negotiation strategies, and GTM narratives.
Partner with account, engagement, industry, sector leaders and teams to shape go-to-market strategy and articulate differentiated value propositions.
Enhance pursuit performance using data-driven insights, deal economics, and financial analysis to inform commercial decisions.
Foster commercial excellence across teams through coaching, collaboration with Global and Super Region Sales and Commercial Excellence teams and alignment with EY’s transformation and GTM priorities.
Create pricing insights tools that can be leveraged across the firm
Become an expert in all existing pricing tools (Regionally and Globally)
Train additional resources in pricing best practices, tools and technology
Develop a network across Super Regions to continually improve our pricing practices

Skills and attributes for success:

Minimum 8-12 years of experience in professional services, consulting, or strategic sales.
Experience in commercial activities, such as go-to-market strategy, pricing and sales
Strong analytical skills, financial analysis and forecasting, strategic thinking, and excellent communication and negotiation skills.
Understanding of engagement lifecycle management, risk assessment, and the ability to interact with senior management levels.
Experience working with senior stakeholders, specifically top team executives.
Strong facilitation, communication, and influencing skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

What We Offer

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any accommodations you may need.

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories
